rule.name: REUSABLE_ACCEPTED_HEAD_ADVANCEMENT_RULE
requires: exact current bound Program operational head Pn
durable exact ACCEPTED_MATERIALIZED acceptance and closure of Pn
fresh compatible master and unchanged architecture/control semantics
following package exists in predecessor remaining lane
allowed: create exactly one separately-bound successor revision
remove only exact accepted current head
next item becomes immediately following package
create exact supersession provenance and revision-specific operational acceptance
rule.idempotency: Same exact predecessor revision/blob and accepted-head closure may have exactly one current successor; existing matching successor is reused as evidence, ambiguity/conflict fails closed; no duplicate successor allocation
rule.terminal_behavior: No successor with fabricated next item; ordinary advancement requires an actual following package
